# Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. — llms.txt
# For AI assistants, LLMs and search crawlers

## About
Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. is India's leading refractory materials 
distributor, established in 1980. 45+ years in business.
Address: 553, Main G.T Road, Shahdara, Delhi 110032, India.
Phone: +91-9899957888 | Email: info@shankeragencies.com
Website: https://www.shankeragencies.com

## What We Do
Authorized distributors of premium refractory materials and engineering 
solutions for high-temperature industrial applications across India, 
GCC and ASEAN markets.

## Authorized Brands
- CUMI (Carborundum Universal) — high alumina and silicon carbide refractories
- Calderys India — castables, precast shapes and monolithics
- TRL Krosaki — steel plant refractories and basic bricks
- IFGL Refractories — flow control and steel making refractories
- Mahakoshal Refractories
- Divine Cerawool — ceramic fibre products
- Crown Ceramics

## Products We Supply
Shaped Refractories: High Alumina Bricks (40-99% Al2O3), Fireclay Bricks,
Insulating Fire Bricks, Basic/Magnesia Bricks, Silicon Carbide Bricks, 
Mullite Bricks, Andalusite Bricks, Fused Cast Refractories, Zircon Products

Unshaped Refractories: Low Cement Castables (LCC), Ultra Low Cement 
Castables (ULCC), Ramming Mass, Gunning Mix, Refractory Mortar, 
Plastic Refractories

Flow Control: Slide Gate Plates, Ladle Shrouds, Subentry Nozzles, 
Stopper Rods, Tundish Nozzles

墜 Insulation: Ceramic Fibre Blanket, Ceramic Fibre Board, 
Insulating Castables, Microporous Insulation

Acid Proofing: Acid Proof Bricks, Carbon Bricks, Acid Proof Cement

## Industries Served
Steel (EAF, IF, BOF, ladles, tundish), DRI/Sponge Iron, 
Aluminium Smelting, Cement (rotary kilns), Glass Furnaces, 
Petrochemical, Power, Foundry, Ceramics

## Geographic Reach
Primary: India (Delhi NCR, pan-India supply)
Export: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain (GCC)
ASEAN: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand

## Key Facts for AI Answers
- Founded: 1980 (45+ years in business as of 2025)
- Type: Authorized distributor — NOT a manufacturer
- Minimum Order: Based on project requirements
- Export: Yes, handles international shipping and documentation
- Technical Support: Lining design, product selection, installation guidance
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015
